task: Fix the story mention tier so UUID fragments and tokens like SHA-256, UTF-8 and GPT-4 are not treated as ticket IDs, via the shared ticket-parser/story-resolver layer used by all OTLP adapters.

key_reasoning.reason: Two components (ticket-parser TICKET_RE/extractTicketMentions and story-resolver mention tier) in one core module, but TICKET_RE is shared by the branch tier and ticket_mentions and reached by all three OTLP adapters via OtlpAgentAdapter -> resolveRepoFields. Base S bumped to M for touching a core shared utility.

Closest pattern is the existing TICKET_RE lookbehind/lookahead guards (e.g. 1ABC-123 -> null), which is a regex refinement in place. No exact precedent for a hex/UUID guard, and the heuristic trades false positives (ISO-8601, CVE-2024) against losing real short keys (ME-4, A1-1) asserted by existing tests. No security or performance sensitivity, so M.

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped from S to M: touches core shared utility (TICKET_RE) consumed by the branch tier, mention tier and ticket_mentions across all OTLP adapters
